title: Marquee Illustrations
slide_intent: Use a larger canvas to stage a fuller story. A heading and action still need a clear place around a scene with several objects and characters.
strategic_value: Instacart can connect groceries with anticipation through a playful email scene while keeping the route to shopping visible.
demonstration: An email example layers a headline, a pink scene containing sweet goods and a figure, supporting copy and a Shop Now button. The explanation places marquee illustrations at the detailed end of the range.
practical_value: Use a marquee when the placement offers enough room for a foreground, a simple setting and a clear reading path to the call to action.

content_islands.name: Marquee guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the section title and criteria for larger scenes on the left side of the dark field.

content_islands.name: Email masthead and hero
content_islands.spec: Center a tall pale email with a compact brand lockup at the top. Follow it with a pink field containing the headline above a layered illustration.

content_islands.name: Email close
content_islands.spec: Place the short explanation and a dark rounded Shop Now button below the scene.
